title: Noether-current and total stress-energy accounting
question: Do the implemented scalar and Proca exchanges cancel between sectors, and do the periodic production equations preserve total stress-energy and conserved currents without spurious sources?
prediction: Across 128 seeded scalar states the homogeneous material-scalar energy residual remains below 1e-13; the integrated Proca-field exchange cancels its Lorentz power and force below 2e-10; and every periodic total-current balance remains below 1e-12.
falsifier: Any registered exchange or periodic balance residual exceeds its tolerance.
controls: The scalar audit differentiates canonical scalar energy and material interaction energy independently at fixed material currents.
The Proca audit starts on the Gauss surface and differentiates the full vector stress along the field equations while evolving source charge by its continuity equation.
The Proca comparison uses the independently evaluated Lorentz power and force returned to matter.
The production balance uses a nonhomogeneous periodic state with moving material and carrier currents, a coherence field, and an excited Proca sector on flat instantaneous geometry.
Damping and irreversible carrier drag are disabled for the reversible exchange audit.
seed_rationale: Constitutive parameters, physical states, coherence amplitudes, and momenta are generated from a fixed NumPy seed.
